review_type: Repository-owner-commissioned AI-assisted Econometrica numerical-methods advisory review
recommendation: Reject in the present form and do not continue the cumulative manuscript through another ordinary revision round. A new, sharply focused paper on certificate-gated prediction-guided Bellman search without state lattices could merit evaluation, but R65 does not establish an Econometrica-level, method-specific contribution for Neural Bellman Operators.

query_count_amortization_diagnostic.scope: One training Bellman query is treated as one deployment Bellman query only for this diagnostic; costs are not assumed equal.

blocking_findings: The successful object is predictor-guided certified action search; validity and termination are predictor-independent, so R65 does not identify a specifically neural numerical contribution.
Adaptive parabolic search or bisection has the lowest complete cold-start median in every one of the eight task-target cells.
The quadratic routed predictor is at least as compelling as the ReLU predictor and has the lower complete-time median in all eight cells.
The localization proposition depends on the unknown true minimizer and its boundary derivative and is not operationalized as a computable training-to-query guarantee.
The repeated-use advantage is not executed; even favorable query-count diagnostics often require hundreds or thousands of repeated identical workloads, and several transcripts have no saving.
No new independent continuous-law expected-policy-cost comparison is supplied for the callable query controllers.
Two fitting seeds and repeat-identical traces do not identify neural training reliability; 104 fitting warnings are retained, concentrated in ReLU services.
State-lattice-free execution remains scalar-control, scalar-innovation and horizon two or three; horizon and shock-tree costs remain material.
The monetary purchase criterion is not empirically calibrated and cannot identify a favorable learned deployment from the deposited evidence.
The broad Neural Bellman Operators framing remains wider than the completed convex scalar expectation result.
positive_findings: R65 is a complete, immutable and clean-rebuildable canonical submission with a much clearer active reading path.
The callable controller is certified against the original continuous-action optimum, including acquisition, rounding and its own future.
Prediction is correctly separated from verification and cannot forge a policy certificate.
Certificate gating reduces deployment queries relative to unconditional insertion in every matched ReLU and quadratic transcript.
The state-lattice-free service returns the 1/128 contract at state dimension sixteen.
All adverse timing, warning, cost-comparison and scope limitations are retained prominently.
Record hashing, replay, rational trajectory reconstruction and publication provenance are exceptionally strong.

limitations: The reviewer did not rerun fitting, Bellman services, policy evaluation, LaTeX or timing experiments; new executions would create new observations.
The reviewer verified the frozen artifact, record arithmetic, publication identities and principal theorem chain, but did not independently re-prove every inherited result.
Single-host clocks are descriptive and support no hardware-general timing inference.
The query-count amortization calculation is diagnostic and does not assume equal cost per training and deployment query.
This advisory review is not an Econometric Society editorial decision.
